acceptance_criteria.text: Scoring gives 0 for wrong or missing answers and 500 plus round(500 × remaining ÷ limit) for correct ones, never rewarding a slower correct answer more, and ranks ties equally in join order.
A question closes at its time limit or when all connected players have answered, answers cannot be changed or submitted late, and disconnected players do not block closing.
Joining validates room code and nickname (trimmed, 1–20 characters, unique ignoring case), refuses joins after the game starts, and refuses the 51st player.
Over WebSocket, a host and players can play a full game from lobby through question, reveal (correct answer, answer spread, scores) and podium, with the correct answer withheld until reveal.
A disconnected player can rejoin by token or by the same nickname and keeps their score and answered state, while a connected player's nickname cannot be taken over.
The bundled sample quiz passes validation and malformed quiz files are rejected without stopping the server.
Malformed, out-of-order or wrong-role messages are ignored without crashing the server or altering game state.
A game with 50 simulated players completes with every client receiving each reveal within 1 second.
Running npm start in quiz/ serves the host page with a room code and scannable QR code, and a phone can join and play the sample quiz.
All files live under quiz/ with their own package.json, nothing outside quiz/ is changed, and nickname and quiz text are rendered as plain text, never as HTML.
